items.title: Target (TGT) Launches Beauty Studio With 1,600 Products From 90 Brands
items.summary: Target (NYSE:TGT) introduced Target Beauty Studio, a new in-store and online specialty beauty destination featuring over 1,600 products from 90 brands. The assortment includes prestige, emerging, and global beauty labels, most of which are new to Target shoppers. Target Beauty Studio offers curated experiences, personalized guidance from Beauty Advisors, and exclusive customer engagement programs. items.title: Our e.l.f. Beauty Stock Pick Had an Ugly Year. Better Days Lie Ahead.
items.summary: Beauty  stock took a hard hit shortly after we published our initial recommendation, but the company has flipped the bearish narrative on the business.  The main pressure point: management’s 2026 sales growth guidance, issued in November of 2025, called for low single digit year over year organic sales growth, which excludes the effect of acquisitions.  Overall growth guidance was higher, given that the acquisition of rhode, Hailey Bieber’s brand, closed.
